description: This Java class defines a fragment for the night mode settings in the AnySoftKeyboard app. It manages preferences related to night mode, updates UI titles, and observes night mode state changes to apply theme updates.

classes.name: NightModeSettingsFragment
classes.description: A fragment that manages the night mode settings UI, including preference loading and observing night mode state changes.

methods.name: onCreatePreferences
methods.description: Loads preferences from the specified XML resource.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Sets the activity title and subscribes to night mode state changes to update the theme accordingly.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Disposes of the night mode subscription to prevent memory leaks.
